outcome: Failure rate of conversion of epidural labor analgesia (ELA) to epidural surgical anesthesia (ESA) for intrapartum cesarean section (CS)
cohort: 214 pregnant women who underwent cesarean section after receiving labor analgesia at the Fujian Maternity and Child Health Hospital
finding: A nomogram incorporating six variables was developed and demonstrated good predictive performance for assessing the risk of failure in converting labor analgesia to cesarean section anesthesia.
